title: Conditional Q3 multivariate edge/bond operator-source bridge and A-power transport boundary
question: Under explicit mixed two-site graph bounds, do the actual Q3 edge and spatial bond source differences admit exact two-orientation operator majorants, and do the one-site bounds alone imply the mixed bounds needed for composition?

model.source_majorant: B_e(S)=sum |coeff(q^i v^j a^k)| M_ij S^k and B_b(S)=sum |coeff(q^i r^j a^k)| M_ij S^k
model.orientation: The reverse endpoint and reverse operator order use the separately declared Mhat table; equality is checked only for the symmetric fixture

hypotheses: A is positive self-adjoint and all mixed monomials act on a declared common core
Both one-sided mixed tables M_ij and Mhat_ij are finite for i+j<=3
The source shift acts at one endpoint; the other endpoint follows only by the symmetric edge formula

conditional_theorem.fixture_consequence: At S=1/4 and M_ij=Mhat_ij=4^(i+j), B_e=69217/3584, B_b=65/48, and the ten-choice local rate is 549079/7168

transport_boundary.matrix_fixture: A=diag(1,16,256), S is the 3x3 raising shift, Q_u=Q_v=S A^(1/4)
transport_boundary.interpretation: Single-site one-sided graph bounds do not imply the mixed product bound with the naive product constant; an explicit mixed graph estimate or A-power transport theorem is required
transport_boundary.nonexistence_scope: This finite obstruction rejects only the inference rule, not the existence of a stronger Q3 mixed bound

M_ij and Mhat_ij are explicit hypotheses; they are not silently derived from the one-coordinate EXP-001043 inputs.
The reversed endpoint has the same scalar coefficient norm by symmetry, but the operator reverse orientation needs Mhat separately.
The finite A=diag(1,16,256) raising-shift fixture has unit one-factor bounds and mixed norm two, so naive composition is invalid.
The source majorants use graph moments, not a pointwise field window; no Q cutoff is claimed.
A one-factor source bridge and a transport obstruction do not prove repeated Duhamel histories, first passage or common alpha.
R226 checks exact rational rates and the scalar norm fixture only; it does not formalize unbounded operators or Q3 dynamics.
No thermodynamic dynamics, OS/KMS reconstruction, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
